rationale: Identity was properly verified via name + ZIP, the correct order was referenced, options were checked with product-detail tools, and the agent obtained explicit user confirmation before submitting the exchange. However, the agent stated specific payment details (credit card ending in 9513926) and exact price/refund amounts without any visible tool support. No tool call retrieved payment methods, and the order/product tool outputs shown do not substantiate the quoted prices or refund ($13.46). The agent also asserted availability of a specific thermostat variant and keyboard alternatives that are not clearly supported by the truncated tool data. Providing potentially fabricated or unsupported details violates the policy. Therefore, despite correct flow and confirmation, the response does not meet the pass bar.
